I've got the water heater at Mesa Vista Unit 7B I need to close out today before Hill Country's Thursday install slot, and I want a fresh look before I sign off.

Quick backstory. Tenant is Tanya, Robert Finley's building. Hill Country was on site Monday afternoon for the diagnostic on a small drip Tanya had flagged. Diane, their AP contact at Hill Country, emailed me the summary that afternoon: exchanger swap and a new thermocouple, right around 310 dollars, in and out Thursday morning. Tony posted in the maintenance channel Monday night endorsing that scope, said the tank held pressure on the hold test and it keeps us on Robert's June budget. He was going to sign off if nobody flagged it by end of business yesterday.

The ticket went in Monday night at medium priority off Tanya's early read on the drip. Then last night Tanya called again and it turned into something different. I dropped an update into the tenant thread I had going but I have not touched the actual maintenance ticket yet.

Before I confirm the work with Hill Country I want somebody to actually go through Diane's diagnostic write-up on the bill itself and check whether the detail she has captured lines up with the summary she and Tony are talking off of. Standard practice on an older unit. I want the paperwork on the fix to sit cleanly against the paperwork on the finding. Whatever the diagnostic actually points to is the scope I want to move on.

Once you've landed the scope, get everything else caught up. Bring the maintenance ticket current with the priority from last night's call and the scope we're actually going with. Update the operations tracking issue so the team sees where it landed, and drop a note walking through the rationale. Drop back into the tenant thread with the same rationale so anyone following sees the call before Hill Country goes ahead. Draft Diane the revised confirmation so she can pull the right parts, Tanya an update on the timing for the week, and Robert a heads-up on the cost. And put the install on my calendar for Thursday morning so I'm blocked out to be onsite when the crew shows up.

Parts need pulling today so Hill Country's ready for Thursday morning.
